decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche far from the core offer and is only mentioned on the website, but naval contracts are long-term and the maritime customer base supports keeping it.
The medical examination light builds on existing competencies, has its own page, and serves institutional customers the firm already reaches.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's certified manufacturing and industrial customer base, and certification costs give it a strong reason to keep the line.
The relaunched designer task light is a popular, established product close to the core offer, so dropping it soon after the relaunch is unlikely.
